title: Holospex integration lab
description: Test the handoff between lesson content, frame overlays, and saved answers using synthetic shapes.
disclaimer: Synthetic integration fixture — not surgical footage, anatomical instruction, or a clinically reviewed lesson.

questions.prompt: Integration check: which class is assigned to the mint polygon? You may inspect labels before answering.

reviewedAnswer.explanation: The mocked result assigns gallbladder to this arbitrary polygon. This tests class IDs and feedback plumbing; the shape is not an anatomical example.

questions.prompt: Can this synthetic illustration establish that the Critical View of Safety is achieved in a surgical case?

reviewedAnswer.explanation: This is an arbitrary illustration, so no surgical judgment can be made. In a real lesson, a clinical reviewer must establish the answer from the supplied case evidence; model availability cannot decide it.
